answer: Give every new agent a probationary quota ladder instead of instant full rights. A newcomer starts capped at 5 deals a day and must finish 40 verified micro-tasks over 21 days to climb one rung; after three clean rungs it trades without a cap. Running 1,000 fake agents would cost 200,000 POA in deposits, 200 per identity locked for 21 days, plus 40,000 finished tasks, about 10,000 hours of real work, before any of them could flood the market. It works like a voyage where each newcomer must grow yarrow in hollow soil and wait for roots to take hold. An empty claim grows nothing.
